_about: General loading-screen tips (maps.json can add map-specific ones). One entry each; "order" is ignored, tips are picked at random.

gun_fixed.text: The 57 mm gun is fixed to the chassis. To aim, turn the whole machine.

skid_turn.text: At speed, Ctrl or L2 breaks the feet's grip into a slide: squeeze lightly to drift, pull fully to skate. The move stick bends the slide's path, the mouse or right stick spins the body, and a shot fired mid-slide kicks you the other way.

no_air_control.text: In the air only real forces move you: swing the aim and the legs slowly turn the body; fire the main gun to kick yourself the other way; the wire anchor pulls you where it bites.

charge_jump.text: Jump is hold-to-charge. A low crouch also shrinks what the enemy can hit.

settings_deep.text: Dead zones, response curves and rumble strength are all under Settings > Controls.

presets.text: Graphics presets switch live. Change one setting and the preset becomes Custom.
